notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Changelog [1.0.1]:
- Fixed enemies not spawning properly in narrow places
- Fixed enemy pathfinding issues after restarting custom map
- Adjusted keybindings for gamepad
- Added Spacebar button as accept action in menus
